general.descriptionTextModule: Maintain information bar messages per sales channel and language

howTo.title: How it works
howTo.item1: Bars are not maintained here but under Content > Information bars.
howTo.item2: Create as many bars as needed per sales channel, each with its own start and end date, for example for promotions.
howTo.item3: A bar without a period runs permanently. While a scheduled bar is active it takes over, and the permanent bar returns afterwards.
howTo.item4: Texts per language: switch the language at the top of the detail page. If a translation is missing, the default language's text is shown.
howTo.item5: Multiple lines in the message field are shown one after another.
howTo.item6: Colours and timezone for new bars: Information bars > Defaults.
howTo.item7: Changes to a bar are visible in the shop right after saving. Start and end take effect within about five minutes — this requires Shopware's scheduled tasks to be running.

info.description: Displays a time-controlled information bar with a customizable message and optional button in the storefront.

defaults.title: Defaults for new bars
defaults.stylingHint: These values are copied when a new bar is created. Existing bars are not affected.
defaults.timezoneHint: Start and end times of all bars are evaluated in this timezone. Unlike the other fields here, it takes effect immediately.

detail.overlapWarning: Overlaps with "{name}" — the later starting bar wins there.
detail.invalidWindowWarning: With this time period the bar will never be shown, because the end date is not after the start date. Please check the start and end date.
detail.dstMissingHourWarning: On {date} the clocks move forward by one hour in the {timezone} timezone. That hour does not exist on this day — please check the time you entered.
detail.dstDuplicateHourWarning: On {date} the clocks move back by one hour in the {timezone} timezone. One hour exists twice on this day — please check the time you entered.
detail.saveTextsError: The texts could not be saved.

detail.loadConfigError: The appearance settings could not be loaded.
detail.appearanceLanguageHint: These settings apply to all languages of the selected sales channel.
detail.messageHint: Allowed: <b> <i> <u> <s> <mark>. Each line is displayed in turn.
detail.warningTagRemoved: {tag} will be removed on save (not allowed).
detail.warningTagAttributes: {tag} will be removed on save (attributes are not allowed).
detail.warningCommentRemoved: An HTML comment will be removed on save.
detail.warningInvisibleRemoved: {count} invisible character will be removed on save (e.g. from pasted text). | {count} invisible characters will be removed on save (e.g. from pasted text).
detail.countdownExpiredTextHelp: Shown once the countdown has expired. Empty = hide the countdown.
detail.countdownBeforeStartWarning: The countdown target is before the bar starts. The countdown would be expired the whole time.
detail.countdownNoEndDateWarning: Set the end date to the countdown target. Otherwise the bar reappears after the event with an expired countdown.
detail.countdownNoMessageWarning: Without a message in this language the bar does not appear in the shop (unless a fallback language applies).
detail.buttonBorderRadiusHelp: Empty = as in the theme. Example: 4px, 999px for a pill shape.
detail.eventCopyExplanation: After the countdown: create a copy of this bar that starts exactly at the countdown target – e.g. for the sale period with its own text, colours and button. Then set the end date in the copy.
detail.eventCopyError: The event bar could not be created.
detail.eventCopyHint: Event bar created. Now set the end date – without one it runs indefinitely.
